title: Azure Acmebot - Zero-Trust Edition
description: Let's Encrypt automation for locked-down Azure environments. Private Link isolation, default-deny network rules, and Managed Identity, built for ISO 27001, NIS2, and KRITIS audits.
bullets: Default-deny network architecture (VNet Integration + Private Link)
Private DNS Zones linked, so names resolve to the private endpoints
Entra ID app registration and Managed Identity set up by Terraform
Full source code, no lock-in

title: Hub & Spoke - Zero-Trust Edition
description: Zero-Trust NSGs, centralized Private DNS, and a DINE policy bypass so Azure Policy remediation does not show up as Terraform drift.
bullets: Zero-Trust NSG baseline bound to all Spoke subnets
Centralized Private DNS Zones (Blob, SQL, Key Vault, ACR)
DINE policy lifecycle bypass, so policy remediation does not break the next plan
Environment-aware naming convention throughout
Full source code, no lock-in

title: Azure Firewall - Forced Tunneling Edition
description: Forced tunneling without the Terraform cycle error, with KMS and Azure AD bypass routes, dynamic IP Groups, and baseline FQDN policies. Drops into an existing Hub & Spoke without breaking Windows activation or Managed Identities.
bullets: Resource ordering that avoids the cycle error on first apply
KMS and Azure AD bypass routes keep Windows activation and sign-in working
Dynamic for_each subnet binding for any number of spokes
IP Group-based firewall policies, no hardcoded IP addresses
FQDN baseline rules for Windows Updates and core Microsoft services

title: Azure OpenAI RAG - Zero-Trust Networking
description: Isolated network layer for an Azure OpenAI RAG stack. Private Endpoints for Azure OpenAI and AI Search, automated Private DNS, and Managed Identity RBAC between them instead of shared keys.
bullets: Private Endpoints for both services, public network access disabled
Identity chaining via Managed Identity and RBAC, no static keys
Automated Private DNS Zone linking for both services
Network and identity design built for ISO 27001 and NIS2 audits

title: Private AKS - Zero-Trust Edition
description: No public API server, no public node IPs, no default outbound path. Forced-tunneled egress via Route Table, private-endpoint-only ACR and Key Vault. Built to run behind your Hub & Spoke.
bullets: private_cluster_enabled with no public FQDN at all
Forced tunneling via userDefinedRouting, no default outbound path
Private-endpoint-only ACR (Premium) and Key Vault, kubelet identity RBAC only
Zero-Trust node subnet NSG, DINE-policy-safe Private DNS Zones
Full source code, no lock-in
